استكثروا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْثَرُوا (istakṯarū) /is.tak.θa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# اُسْتُكْثِرُوا (ustukṯirū) /us.tuk.θi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# اِسْتَكْثِرُوا (istakṯirū) /is.tak.θi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
